headline: Malibu Boats Beats Earnings Estimates Despite Revenue Miss
summary: Malibu Boats Inc. reported quarterly earnings that exceeded analyst expectations by $0.07 per share, though total revenue fell short of estimates.
why: Malibu Boats is a manufacturer of recreational powerboats; mixed results often lead to complex price action as investors weigh profitability against top-line growth.

impacts.name: Malibu Boats Inc
impacts.why: The company beat earnings expectations but missed on revenue.
